source: Solid allotropes of an element on its phase diagram. Carbon: graphite–diamond equilibrium line P(kbar) = 19.4 + T(°C)/40 measured over 1100–1625 °C by C. S. Kennedy and G. C. Kennedy, J. Geophys. Res. 81, 2467 (1976), extended linearly; graphite and diamond melting curves from Table 2 of L. M. Ghiringhelli et al., Mol. J. Basset, J. Phys.
